summary: Quiet street where cars park nightly; apartments about 16-20 m behind the kerb.
reasons: Many cars parked along this kerb

best_section.where: Carr Street west kerb, opposite the St Lucia Bowling Club

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks 16-20 m behind a hedged strip; bowls club and trees opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with a parking lane on the west side, lined with parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end side street serving a club and flats; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the whole kerb, but seven No Stopping Any Time signs run along it.

flags: Seven No Stopping Any Time signs; imagery shows cars parked beside them

Apartments 10-25 m on the same side
sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the east and overhead in places; open to the west afternoon sun.
